name: qa-loop
description: The QA retest loop around qa-agent: what changed on a ticket since my last comment, open drafts and unrestored test data, a test-data ledger with a restore check, safe browser helpers (tab guard, yopmail OTP reader, toast capture, waits) and Jira comments from templates with a lint check, auto-saved posted copies and comment edits. Requires qa-agent. No MCP servers.
